# CBR

> > CBR is a pop culture entertainment news and opinion site covering movies, TV shows, anime, comics, and video games with reviews, analysis, and industry updates.

CBR (Comic Book Resources) delivers breaking news, in-depth analysis, and critical commentary on franchises like Star Wars, Marvel Cinematic Universe, DC Universe, anime series from Crunchyroll and Netflix, and gaming. The site features exclusive interviews with creators like James Gunn, character analysis, streaming updates, and ranked lists of genre entertainment.

## Key Topics

- Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU)
- Star Wars & Lucasfilm
- DC Universe & James Gunn
- Anime (Shonen, Crunchyroll)
- Netflix & Streaming Services
- Character Analysis
- Game Rankings & Metroidvania
- Attack on Titan
- Demon Slayer
- Peacemaker & DCU TV
- Rotten Tomatoes Reviews
- Apple TV+ Originals
- Sequel Trilogy Analysis
- Anime Criticism & Reviews
